_note: Re-skin the whole site from here. app.js writes every token below onto :root as a CSS custom property at boot, overriding the defaults in assets/css/variables.css. Names must match the token names in that file.
_presetNote: Leave empty to use the tokens below. Set to 'citrus', 'berry' or 'ocean' to use a ready-made palette from assets/css/theme.css instead.
_swatchNote: Category tile colours, used by the generated SVG placeholder when a remote image is unavailable.
